note: Three legs, and they assert the OPPOSITE of what this row used to. (1) publish to a prefix with a marker VERSION, leave the source in place, run <prefix>/bin/utilz version with UTILZ_HOME EXPORTED at the source: THE MARKER COMES BACK. The inherited value has no effect. (2) stderr is SILENT -- there is no announcement, because there is no divergence to announce; assert stderr is empty, not merely that stdout is right. (3) a child process resolves correctly: run a DISPATCHED utility the same way and assert it too answers from the prefix, which proves the dispatcher exported the derived value rather than merely using it locally.
